reason_for_revision: User prioritizes a voice-coil prototype and integrated sensing/amplification electronics for customizability, ease of use, programming and robustness.

decision_basis.priority: Lower nominal force error and direct programmable current-to-force actuation; accept higher modeled winding loss subject to thermal validation.

pcb.location: Rigidly mounted on S; board, mounting and associated downstream mass included in identified S mass
pcb.relative_position_input: S relative to A; separate input, not a spare M04 channel
pcb.power_driver_location: On A, with coil-current switching and cooling separated from low-level sensing on S

scope: One-axis axial-force prototype, ignoring axial drag coupling. Existing 2 s loaded-equilibrium fixed-robot tests are development evidence, not engagement, recentering, calibration or thermal qualification.
unverified_hardware_targets: relative force/acceleration timestamp residual at most 2 us
driver current response and continuous hot force

manufacturer_sources_reviewed.supports: Three analog acceleration outputs with configurable analog bandwidth; C variant supports +/-8 g range.
Four-channel simultaneous-sampling ADC with SPI interface.
